Name: European Space Agency - ESA
Description: We are the European Space Agency. Our mission is the peaceful exploration and use of space for the benefit of everyone. We watch over Earth, develop and launch inspiring space projects, train astronauts and push the boundaries of science and technology, seeking answers to the big questions about the Universe. We are scientists, engineers and business professionals from all over Europe working together in a diverse and multinational environment. We are dedicated to united space in Europe and united Europe in space.

Name: EUSPA - EU Agency for the Space Programme
Description:
The EU Agency for the Space Programme (EUSPA) provides safe and performant space services, enabling synergies, EU innovation, sustainability, and security.

To achieve this, EUSPA manages the Galileo and EGNOS programmes, develops markets for Copernicus services and data, is involved in secure satcom (GOVSATCOM & IRIS2), and carries out work in various areas targeted at Security, Research and Development and increasing space’s contribution to the EU Market. The Agency is also responsible for the security accreditation of all the components of the EU Space Programme. EUSPA also operates the #EUSST Front Desk, protecting more than 400 satellites from the risk of collision with space debris or other operational satellites.

EUSPA, staffed with skilled professionals bringing relevant experience from the public and private sectors, is unique in contributing to one of the most important and ambitious projects ever undertaken by the EU. We are committed to implementing the EU Space Programme and turning the EU space ambitions into a reality.

Name: HyPrSpace
Description:
HyPrSpace is making the first scalable hybrid rocket engine, combining simplicity, robustness and reactivity. We embody the audacity and boldness of innovating in a world driven by caution and conformism.

We believe the best way of winning the space race is by building our own tracks. That is why we created HyPrSpace, redefining propulsion with a one-of-a-kind rocket.

Thanks to a robust and reliable patented hybrid rocket technology, HyPrSpace is giving Europe a cost-effective and sovereign path to space. 

We call it ‘Baguettes’.

Name: GEOFIT
Description:
French company created in 1968 in Nantes, GEOFIT is today a key player in regional and city development, bringing together more than 1,400 employees with its subsidiaries.

Our business consists of measuring, quantifying, and analysing geospatial data to transform them into real decision-making tools.

By relying on its committed teams, GEOFIT contributes every day to supporting and securing development and land projects, in France and around the world.
Location: Nantes, Pays de la Loire, France

Name: PROMÉTHÉE Earth Intelligence
Description:
Prométhée Earth Intelligence est le premier opérateur français Newspace de constellation de nanosatellites d’observation de la terre dont l’objectif est de démocratiser l’utilisation de l’imagerie  satellitaire pour un monde plus sûr et durable.
PROMÉTHÉE Earth Intelligence répond ainsi aux enjeux de gestion de crise et de développement durable en fournissant des services d’intelligence stratégique et d’intelligence environnementale.
Le champ d’application que propose PROMÉTHÉE Earth Intelligence est pratiquement illimité, de la surveillance maritime, des infrastructures critiques ; en passant par la protection des écosystèmes, des ressources hydriques, de la faune et de la flore ; la lutte contre la déforestation, la pêche illégale ou encore la prévention face aux catastrophes naturelles.
Fondée en janvier 2020, Prométhée Earth Intelligence a reçu l’appui du gouvernement français, de la Banque publique d’investissement (BPI) et du Centre national des études spatiales (CNES) dans le cadre du programme France-Relance. Membre du Groupement des industries françaises aéronautiques et spatiales (GIFAS), elle a conclu des partenariats avec plus de 50 sociétés françaises et européennes ; le premier satellite, Protométhée Earth Intelligence, a été lancé le 11 novembre 2023 de la base de Vandenberg, Californie.

Name: NATO Space Centre of Excellence
Description:
NATO Space COE is not a part of the NATO Command Structure or other NATO entities nor an operational entity. Its Steering Committee (SC) is the body responsible for guidance and supervision of all activities and administration of the COE, within the framework of the Operational Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) that was signed by 15 sponsoring nations (Kingdom of Belgium, the Czech Republic, the French Republic, the Federal Republick of Germany, the Hellenic Republic, the Italian Republic, the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, the Kingdom of the Netherlands, the Republic of North Macedonia, the Republic of Poland, the Republic of Portugal, Romania, the Kingdom of Spain, the Republic of Türkiye, and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland) in January 2023.
The role of the NATO Space COE is to act as a catalyst for the comprehension, improvement, and transformation of Space Power by delivering effective and efficient solutions to the benefit of NATO and its Allies.
This role includes: Concept development and experimentation; Development of space military doctrine and standardization; Education, training and exercise; and Analysis and lessons learned process.
The NATO Space COE will provide knowledge, analysis, and products covering the three operational Space functions (Space Domain Awareness, Operational Space Support, and Space Domain Coordination), stimulate Space expertise sharing and interoperability, and constitute a bridge between NATO and all relevant national and international Space organizations from various sectors (Defense, Civil, Industry, Academia and Research).

Name: IRAP - Institut de Recherche en Astrophysique et Planétologie
Description:
IRAP’s scientific objectives concern the study and understanding of the Universe and its contents: the Earth as a planet, its ionized space environment, the sun and its planets, the stars and their planetary systems, the interstellar environment , galaxies, the very first stars and the primordial Big Bang.
With activities of design, construction, integration and operation of instruments on the ground and in space as well as laboratory experiments allowing the characterization of physical processes, IRAP is one of the major poles of ground-space astrophysics in France.
IRAP has numerous collaborations both regionally and internationally with organizations such as CNES, ESA, ESO, NASA, JAXA ...
IRAP benefits from numerous fundings through calls for projects, notably within the framework of the National Research Agency (ANR) and the Horizon 2020 program of the European Union.

Name: AstroAgency
Description:
AstroAgency is the world’s first strategic communications firm dedicated exclusively to the commercial space sector. 

By combining marketing expertise with our team’s technical understanding and space industry experience, we’ve successfully delivered projects with more than 80 international space companies, as well as several governments and academic institutions around the world (including national Space Agencies and regional economic development bodies leveraging space to bring prosperity through job creation and satellite data applications). 

We support existing space companies within the launch supply chain through to downstream data analytics, and non-space organisations looking to take advantage of the growing space economy, to shape their space sector messaging and target their outreach. We provide an integrated, full-service solution that combines strategic communications, digital marketing, PR, networking introductions, events strategies, market guidance and investment support, all underpinned by market intelligence.

AstroAgency - Changing the Perception of Space.

Name: SpaceFounders
Description:
SpaceFounders is a unique European community driving momentum in the space industry. 

A partnership between the French space Agency, the Italian space agency and the Bundeswehr University Munich, we’re uniquely placed to bring private and public sector pioneers together to create the space leaders of tomorrow.

Name: AVS Added Value Solutions
Description:
AVS Added Value Solutions (AVS) is an international SME which provides complex instrumentation that boost the value of our customer throughout a wide range of applications. AVS is strongly focused on the development of outstanding devices, instruments, mechatronics and vacuum systems. Our expertise covers design, manufacturing, assembly, tests and supply, covering the whole product lifecycle for our customers. 

AVS skills on engineering design, mechatronics, instrumentation, thermal-vacuum systems, micro-mechanisms, opto-mechatronics, and high-precision positioning systems in hazards environments (vacuum, radiation, high magnetic fields, cryogenics...). We "boost scientific knowledge" in the fields of Accelerators, Astronomy, Nuclear Fusion, and Space.

And all is done under the ISO 9001 and EN 9100 certifications, with the advantage of the on-site manufacturing workshops, assembly, integration and cleaning labs, clean rooms, thermal and fluidic testing facilities, bake-out chambers, dust vacuum chambers, propulsion testing labs, etc. across the main 6 sites of the group (3 in Spain, 2 in the UK and 1 in the US).

Name: TerraWatch Space
Description: Strategic Advisory and Market Intelligence firm focused on the Earth observation sector.

Name: Alpha Impulsion
Description:
Alpha Impulsion is pioneering the autophage rocket engine to propel the next generation of light launchers. By using the fuel as the rocket’s structure, we eliminate the need for fuel tanks, multiple stages, and other heavy components that don’t contribute to propulsion. Based in France and Italy, we aim at building the most cost-efficient European launcher for small satellites by 2028  

We are proud to be trusted by numerous European partners, including CNES, ESA BIC Sud France & Turin, the Takeoff accelerator & Bpifrance.

Name: Committee on Space Research - COSPAR
Description:
The Committee on Space Research (COSPAR) is an international scientific organization established in 1958, under the International Science Council (ISC). Its mission is to promote cooperation in space research, exchange scientific results and information, and develop global partnerships across space science disciplines.  It is the premier space science forum worldwide.

Through its scientific Commissions, Panels and Task Groups, COSPAR covers all space science fields, including Earth observation, planetary protection, astrophysics, and space life sciences and is a trusted advisor to the United Nations. It plays a key role in fostering collaboration between the global scientific community, space agencies, industry, and emerging space nations. Through specialized capacity building workshops it supports the growth of space science expertise worldwide. Its biennial event, the COSPAR Scientific Assembly, brings together thousands of researchers from around the world, serving as a major platform for knowledge exchange and international dialogue.

Name: 3D PLUS
Description:
3D PLUS develops and manufactures miniaturized electronic modules for the space industry. Our technology enables stacking heterogeneous active, passive, and opto-electronic devices in a single highly miniaturized package. 

Our product range includes memory, computer cores, interfaces, power solutions, protection ICs, camera heads, camera systems, and custom SiP solutions. With over 220,000 components in space and more than 25 years of flight heritage, 3D PLUS serves the global space industry for various applications and it is expanding continuously with products launched in space every month in GEO, MEO, and LEO orbits, for deep space exploration missions, for satellite constellation fleets, and for governmental missions.

We focus on the demand for high-reliability and high-performance for space-saving technology-driven applications in industrial, computing/telecommunications, security and defense, avionics, and space markets.

Name: ALATYR
Description:
ALATYR develops robotically assembled Orbital Data Centers - megawatt-scale compute hubs in space with microsecond internal latency.

Why it matters:

• In a new digital era defined by resilience, sovereignty, and security, ALATYR ensures guaranteed service continuity for mission-critical systems, enabling governments and global industries to operate with unprecedented reliability

• With a 10x expansion of space-originated data, ALATYR powers global intelligence and next-generation predictive models across defense & security, climate, risk & insurance, and large-scale industrial systems

Beyond data centers:

• By pioneering in-orbit robotic assembly and maintenance, ALATYR enables a new class of space infrastructure - more scalable and sustainable than constellations - unlocking entirely new activities and businesses in orbit

• By relocating the most energy-intensive industries beyond Earth - powered by abundant and continuous solar energy in space - ALATYR reduces pressure on terrestrial energy systems and resources

ALATYR is shaping the future of space - to make Earth more resilient, sustainable, and secure.

#OrbitalDataCenters

Name: Sensing Atmospheric Intelligence
Description:
Sensing is a European technology company specialising in monitoring, understanding and predicting atmospheric changes.
Through its breakthrough high-resolution hyperspectral sensors and sovereign control of its artificial intelligence models, Sensing provides governments and industrial operators worldwide with continuous monitoring and crisis management services essential to operational resilience while accelerating decarbonisation efforts. 

The company is headquartered in Toulouse, France’s leading centre of excellence for the space industry.

Name: GRASP Earth
Description:
We are a research-driven company specializing in Earth Observation, remote sensing, and environmental sciences. Our goal is to develop and implement technologies that improve the monitoring and understanding of the Earth's atmosphere and surface.

Our main area of expertise is the monitoring of aerosols and particulate matter. We use polarimetric observations, which are widely recognized in the scientific community as the most effective method for observing these particles in the atmosphere. Our work combines advanced algorithms, computing tools, and data from both ground-based and satellite instruments to extract accurate and consistent information on air quality and atmospheric composition.

One of our key innovations is the GRASP algorithm (Generalized Retrieval of Atmosphere and Surface Properties), which improves the interpretation of satellite and ground data through synergetic retrieval, providing detailed information on atmospheric and surface properties. GRASP is used operationally in public Earth Observation missions such as Sentinel-4, 3MI, and CO2M. It is also central to our second major innovation: a private constellation of MAP (Multi-Angle Polarimetric) nano-satellites. These satellites collect aerosol data that is integrated with public datasets using GRASP, providing a more complete and accurate understanding of atmospheric processes.

Our team combines expertise across a broad spectrum of scientific and engineering fields including physics, atmospheric and environmental sciences, mathematics, ML/AI, data science, and remote sensing, working collaboratively to develop solutions that address urgent global environmental issues.

With the first private polarimetric mission operational, we strive to be leaders in air quality monitoring.

Name: CyberInflight
Description: CyberInflight is an independant consulting and business intelligence company dedicated to the topic of Aerospace Cybersecurity. CyberInflight’s goal is to raise the global cybersecurity awareness of aerospace stakeholders providing them with refined information and analysis. Its expertise combines strategic market intelligence and technical proficiency, both required in the demanding field of cybersecurity.

Name: Venturi Space
Description:
Founded in 2000 in Monaco, Venturi has established itself in the field of high-performance electric mobility: world records, expeditions in extreme environments, Formula E, technological innovations and iconic two- and four-wheeled vehicles.

Since 2021, Venturi Space has been applying this expertise to space exploration by designing mobility solutions for the Moon and Mars. 

As strategic partner of the US-based company Venturi Astrolab, Venturi Space designs and manufactures critical technologies for Astrolab: hyper-deformable wheels, high-performance batteries and battery management systems.

As the result of an initial collaboration, Venturi Astrolab’s FLIP lunar rover will be deployed on the Moon during the second half of 2026. Venturi Astrolab’s CLV-1 rover will then be deployed in 2028 as part of NASA’s Artemis IV mission. Finally, around 2030, MONA LUNA, Venturi Space’s 100% European lunar rover, could be sent to the lunar South Pole.

Name: CESBIO
Description: La vocation du Centre d'Etudes Spatiales de la BIOsphère (Cesbio) est de développer des connaissances sur le fonctionnement de la biosphère continentale en faisant un usage important de la télédétection spatiale. Ces connaissances lui permettent de proposer de nouvelles missions spatiales d’observation de la Terre.

Name: ESA Space Economy
Description: The European Space Agency is Europe's gateway to space. Its mission is to shape the development of Europe's space capability and ensure that investment in space continues to support the competiveness of European industry and deliver benefits to the citizens of Europe and the world. For this purpose, ESA has been measuring the impact of its activities and programmes since the nineties, gathering best practices from the experience of its Member States. Therefore, it functions as central hub for current trends and developments of the European space-economy and conducts regular socio-economic impact studies of ESA programmes.

Name: TECHNATIUM NewSpace
Description:
TECHNATIUM is a DeepTech player by bringing to market a set of geospatial mapping solutions to democratize and facilitate access to the use of spatial data to solve socio-economic challenges on a global scale. Technatium produces a range of solutions for the security, safety, defense, environment and land management sectors. (dual GEOINT/geospatial intelligence solutions, predictive mapping, forest and biodiversity monitoring solutions, etc.)

Name: SEEDS - SpacE Exploration and Development Systems Project
Description:
The international Master in "SpacE Exploration and Development Systems" (SEEDS) started in 2005 following a proposal of Politecnico di Torino addressed to its European partners.   
SEEDS is focused on the human and robotic exploration of space and on the related missions, systems, and technologies. 
The purpose of the programme is to provide young graduates with the core applied physics and engineering skills required to develop space systems and missions from initial concept through design, assembly and verification, to launch and operations.
To reach these objectives, SEEDS relies on the tight collaboration of three European Higher Education Institutions located in three different countries, namely Politecnico di Torino in Italy, Institut Supérieur de l’Aéronautique et l’Espace (ISAE, Toulouse) in France and University of Leicester in the UK. 
All three partners share common features, including strong links with space industry, heritage in space research and exploration and inclusion of high-level expertise in the delivery of teaching, based on both the academia and the industry.

Name: STEEL Electronique
Description:
STEEL Electronique, subsidiary of ACTIA Aerospace, is a leading space electronics equipment supplier dedicated to driving innovation and excellence in the field of legacy Full-Space and lower cost New-Space products.

Thanks to its flexible structure and responsiveness, STEEL has the agility of a Small & Medium-sized enterprise, while still being able to meet the requirements and standards of Large Scale Integrators and space agencies. With over 50 years of developing advanced space electronics, STEEL Electronique is a leading space pioneer with a well-established name and reputation.

From specification analysis to development, design, prototyping, testing, manufacturing and quality assurance, STEEL Electronique works throughout the entire value chain of its cusotomers projects, right through to product commissioning. 

Supporting public, institutional and private partners, STEEL Electronique has succeeded achieving most ambitious projects. 

+20 type of space products

+50 years experience

+100 international space missions

+500 satellites equipped

ACTIA Aerospace, a division of ACTIA Group, specializes in advanced electronics and telecommunications systems for the most challenging environments. As a global leader, ACTIA Aerospace leverages its cutting-edge expertise to support the Aeronautics, Space and SatCom sectors serving civil, government and defence markets. With 300 dedicated employees out of the Group's 3,800-strong workforce and an annual turnover of 81.7 million euros (2025), ACTIA Aerospace is a trusted partner to leading stakeholders. ACTIA Aerospace designs, manufactures and supports mission-critical systems, with unmatched performance, reliability and innovation. Built on decades of experience, the company distinguishes itself by managing the entire value chain, in fields where there is no room for compromise.

Name: ConnectSAT aerospace Lab
Description: ConnectSAT Aerospace Lab  is dedicated to advancing space technologies, including propulsion systems, satellite payloads, ground systems, and deep space logistics. We collaborate with startups, major companies, academic institutions, and research organizations on innovative space projects aligned with our goal of democratizing access to space and its resources. Our focus is on delivering the world's most affordable connectivity, supporting space explorers with logistics, and providing geospatial data to organizations.

Description: Procrastinating? You're in the right place.

Name: NAASC Centre Spatial Universitaire de Nouvelle Aquitaine
Description:
NAASC est une association d’établissements d’enseignement supérieur de Nouvelle-Aquitaine, qui forment pour le domaine spatial civil et militaire.

Ses principaux objectifs :

Stimuler l’innovation en impliquant les étudiants dans des projets collaboratifs interétablissements, tout en leur permettant de découvrir l’importance stratégique du transport spatial ainsi que le haut niveau technologique des produits et la qualité de notre outil industriel.
Dynamiser le tissu industriel en développant des modules de formation initiale et continue au service du transport spatial.
Favoriser la dynamique intergénérationnelle et les vocations en créant un lieu de rencontre, de partage et de travail entre industriels, académiques et étudiants, véritable vitrine de la filière aérospatiale.
NAASC permet également de :

Favoriser une connaissance mutuelle des activités menées par les différents membres, et l’animation de la communauté ainsi rassemblée, de façon à développer des collaborations pertinentes plus étroites.
Favoriser le lien entre l’enseignement supérieur et les acteurs institutionnels et industriels du spatial.
Assurer au plan national et international une visibilité aux activités menées dans le cadre du NAASC à travers, en particulier, l’organisation de conférences, de séminaires et d’écoles d’été.

Name: Sanctuary On The Moon
Description:
Sanctuary is a compact collection of sapphire discs engraved with billions of pixels describing who we are, what we know and what we make as humans.

It will land on the Moon, as part of the NASA Artemis program, within the next few years and stay on the surface for the millions of years to come - making it a unique philosophical & anthropological journey and a never-seen-before opportunity for humankind to protect and transmit its heritage to future generations.

 Sanctuary est une capsule temporelle composée de disques de saphir gravés avec des milliards de pixels. Sa mission : décrire qui nous sommes, ce que nous savons et ce que nous faisons en tant qu'humain.  

Elle sera posée sur la surface lunaire dans le cadre du programme NASA Artemis et y restera pour des millions d'années à venir. Un voyage philosophique et anthropologique unique pour l’éternité. Une opportunité sans précédent pour l'humanité de protéger et transmettre son héritage aux générations futures.

Name: TOLOSAT
Description: TOLOSAT is a student nano-satellite Project. It gathers more than 70 students from Toulouse from 5 different schools: ISAE-SUPAERO via its Cubesat Club Supaero, and INSA, ENAC, ENSEEIHT, and Paul Sabatier University UT3 through the ASTRE association. Organized into various subsystems teams, we developing a 3U Cubesat, which will carry a dual student mission. The first will be to conduct a study of Earth's gravitational field, which represents a significant challenge. The second mission will demonstrate the technology of using a satellite constellation to communicate with a Cubesat in low orbit. This ambitious project is led by students passionate about space. To learn more, meet us, or join the adventure by offering any kind of help, do not hesitate to contact us.

Name: Weeroc
Description:
Weeroc is a spin-off company from Omega laboratory (IN2P3/CNRS, french governmental agency for fundamental research in astrophysics, particle physics and nuclear physics). Weeroc designs and provides analogue and mixed ASICs for industry. Our main customers are major actors in the following fields:

Medical imaging
Homeland security
Nuclear protection
Scientific instrumentation
Space (launchers and satellites)
Weeroc helps its customers with the following products and services:

We provide on-the-shelf programmable analogue and mixed front-end ASICs for photodetector and particle detector read-out.
We design dedicated ASICs for a customer and provide designed ASICs on request with full exclusivity
We can act as a design house and design specific product to a customer with IP transfer
We can act as auditor and provide expertise on external projects

Name: Hybrogines
Description: Hybrogines is a French innovative startup dedicated to making space accessible to all by providing more affordable, safe, reliable, and sustainable solutions — including suborbital flights, small satellite launches, and orbital services.

Name: Euclid Consortium
Description:
The Euclid Consortium is an organisation that brings together more than 2000 researchers across theoretical physics, particle physics, astrophysics and space astronomy, alongside engineers, technicians, and management and administrative staff. Consortium members work in public research laboratories or universities and together contribute to the future success of the European Space Agency (ESA) Euclid mission.

Euclid is a medium-class ESA mission designed to map the universe and to better understand its unknown components, dark energy and dark matter, and its eventual fate. Scheduled for launch on July 1st, 2023 aboard a Falcon 9 rocket (SpaceX), within a month Euclid will join ESAs GAIA satellite and NASA's JWST at Lagrange point L2. From there it will survey 15,000 deg2, around one third of the entire sky, over the course of its 6-year mission.

Name: Augura Space
Description: Augura Space delivers AI-powered space weather intelligence - from historical analysis to real-time monitoring and predictive forecasts - to protect aerospace, energy, and telecom infrastructure.

Name: Alya Space
Description:
Alya Space is focused on earth observation through a nanosatellite constellation in low orbit.

Alya's central vision is to create a global network of partnerships for mutual and sustainable development, utilizing shared space systems to generate positive impacts on the quality of life in communities. This includes fostering economic development and job creation as a way to combat and eradicate poverty.

The project's primary goal is to produce reliable and accessible data to monitor various aspects such as the environment (forests, oceans, rivers), agriculture, mineral exploration, and oil and gas. Additionally, it aims to monitor clean energy generation systems.

Alya stands out as a pioneering private company in the space sector, headquartered in Salvador-Bahia. It possesses an experimental farm in the semi-arid region of Tucano, where calibration activities for sensors in orbit will be conducted. This will generate reliable satellite data and simulate areas for the production of vegetation, soil, and water parameters. Through this process, algorithms will be developed to assist the artificial intelligence systems of orbiting sensors in recognizing identical parameters, creating alerts, and enabling efficient monitoring.

Strategically located in Brazil, we will construct one of the country's first commercial ground stations. This facility will serve as the hub for controlling and managing the activities of our satellite constellation, as well as tracking, monitoring, or facilitating data transfer for any other satellite entering our territory.

Alya is also in the process of incorporation in Europe, a strategic move to globalize our activities and leverage competencies from previous experiences. This involves forming more than a dozen commercial partnerships, adding significant value and reliability to our space activities with earth observation nanosatellites and developing shared mission systems.

Name: EU PROTECT
Description:
Launched in June 2022, PROTECT aims at levering innovation procurement and foster the funding of R&I services that will help unlock the climate services’ market potential to support urgent climate change adaptation and mitigation  

 During its two-year duration, PROTECT will prepare the operational ground for one or more joint, cross border or coordinated pre-commercial procurement (PCP) processes to be implemented after the project end (May 2024). PROTECT will engage with an extensive and varied community of public buyers to foster and support a ‘buying with impact’ approach. Clearer, less fragmented demand shall guide and support R&D for future climate services.  

Specifically, PROTECT will provide: 
o	Assistance in defining and aggregating clear and realistic needs for climate services 
o	Experience sharing and good practice transfer with procurement peers from all over the EU
o	Insights into climate services’ marker providers’ existing and future solutions and technologies. 
o	Targeted training, continuous knowledge and fresh information on Earth observation, climate services and innovation procurement
o	Strategic positioning for participation in the upcoming Pre-Commercial Procurement procedure(s)

 In this frame, PROTECT will support the shaping of climate change adaptation and mitigation solutions and services using Earth Observation data that best address the needs of the public demand, both specific and systemic

NeurAstra is an independent science organisation based in the French and Swiss Alps, gathering international professionals in domains as diverse as biology, medicine, engineering, history, and geography. Together, we aim to develop inspiring projects to investigate, understand, and highlight the human potential for adaptation in remote and extreme environments on Earth—and beyond. Name: Groupe Absolut
Description:
L’innovation cryogénique au service de la décarbonation, de la fiabilisation et du contrôle de l’infrastructure énergétique.
 
Depuis plus de 10 ans le groupe Absolut est reconnu pour sa capacité d’innovation et un savoir-faire unique en cryogénie multi-secteurs. 
Avec des compétences en développement de systèmes de refroidissement complexes, nos équipes transforment la gestion de l’énergie et le déploiement d’alternatives aux énergies fossiles. 
Nos systèmes cryogéniques à la pointe de la technologie améliorent les performances de la production, la distribution et l’utilisation de l’énergie.

Name: Stratolia
Description:
Stratolia is building the operating system for the stratosphere.

We develop mission software that enables operators to plan, simulate, navigate and supervise stratospheric balloon missions using advanced weather intelligence, trajectory modelling and mission optimisation.

Our technology helps teams identify the best launch windows and locations, anticipate balloon trajectories, evaluate mission feasibility and adapt operational decisions throughout the flight.

Designed for government, defence, research and commercial operators, Stratolia provides the software foundation required to make stratospheric operations more reliable, scalable and sovereign.

Description:
SupaeroMoon is a student club working on the development of autonomous rovers. The club allows students to develop their practical engineering skills working on the various mechanical, electrical, communications, and autonomy systems of the rover projects. 

SupaeroMoon is currently working on the development of a rover for the European Rover Challenge (ERC).

Name: CAMPUS DE L'ESPACE
Description:

Name: Stratoflight
Description:
Stratoflight is a French company developing a multimodal manned vehicle for stratospheric flights using a zero-pressure balloon. Business activities include space tourism and scientific missions. Stratoflight is the operator of the flights.
Under a balloon using decarbonated hydrogen, a capsule will reach the altitude of 35,000 meters where six passengers (4 passengers and 2 pilots) can stay for up to one hour. The descent will begin by venting some of the lifting gas. Once the altitude of 8,000 m is reached, the capsule is released and a high performance parafoil is deployed. The two pilots will fly the vehicle to a selected landing field and will land at low speed. 
Key developments include the manned vehicle, specific types of parafoils for the descent and pressure suit for passengers. Several innovations will be patented. 
Space tourism is a nascent market targeting individuals looking for unique experiences. 
Beyond the ecological aspect of using decarbonated hydrogen, the main differentiating factor of the project is the extra-vehicular activity (EVA) taking place from a balcony at the rear of the capsule. From there, passengers can admire the extraordinary view and the earth curvature from a horizon from Amsterdam to Barcelona equipped with pressure suits like astronauts.
The first flight is scheduled for 2025.

Name: SOLER Project
Description:
The SOLER Project has received funding from the European Union's Horizon Europe research and innovation programme (Grant agreement ID: 101134999). 

This project will investigate the most energetic phenomena occurring at the Sun and provide new knowledge on their interrelations, variability and energy partitioning. 

Using the newly expanded unprecedented heliospheric spacecraft fleet we investigate energetic solar eruptions starting from three perspectives: fast coronal mass ejections (CMEs), strong X-ray flares, and large solar energetic particle (SEP) events. Key parameters of the various eruption phenomena will be determined and their interrelations examined to make significant leaps in our understanding on how the eruptive phenomena are linked to each other, how they interact with each other, and how they result in acceleration and release of high energy particles from the solar corona into interplanetary (IP) space. 

Because of their direct link to particle energisation, large-amplitude coronal waves and shocks related to these events will be in focus as well. Magnetic connections of sources with each other and with the in-situ observers will be determined. 

In addition to producing significant amounts of new scientific knowledge in the field, SOLER will provide the wider scientific community a wide array of advanced data products, and novel data analysis and visualisation tools that will be openly distributed. This will greatly facilitate future interdisciplinary studies of energetic solar eruptions.

Name: Integradiv project
Description: Assessing current and future patterns of biodiversity and their underlying drivers is critical to developing relevant conservation programmes and promoting sustainable development and human well-being. While research and action to conserve biodiversity has so far focused on taxonomic diversity alone, consideration of the diversity of organismal traits (functional) and evolutionary lineages (phylogenetic) holds promise for effective conservation and maintenance of resilient ecosystems to global change. Indeed, taxonomic, functional and phylogenetic facets of biodiversity do not respond to drivers, especially anthropogenic perturbations, at the same rate, scale or in the same way. The fragmented nature of our knowledge of biodiversity severely limits our ability to anticipate current and future conservation needs. The main objective of INTEGRADIV is to develop an integrative approach to provide guidance on how taxonomic, functional and phylogenetic facets of biodiversity should be incorporated into realistic conservation plans. INTEGRADIV relies on the assessment of ecosystem integrity (its degree of conservation) and vulnerability to global change, based in particular on an innovative quantification of distributions of trait-based and phylogenetic attributes. The project will benefit from both existing and newly collected occurrence, trait and phylogenetic data to develop an innovative biodiversity assessment framework considering multiple spatial scales (regional and Euro-Mediterranean) and taxonomic groups. Considering the diversity of trees, butterflies and birds in the Euro-Mediterranean biodiversity hotspot, the key questions addressed by INTEGRADIV are 1) Where are the areas of high biodiversity value? 2) What is the ecological integrity of Euro-Mediterranean forests? 3) How have spatial patterns of biodiversity been shaped and how vulnerable are they to climate and land-use changes?

Name: DISPEC Project
Description:
The DISPEC project offers new high-level data products based on advanced data processing techniques that improve data quality, provides estimates of ionospheric characteristics based on the joint processing of space and ground data, provides results from post-processing of data for improved ionospheric specification, and exploits long-term time series for the study of long-term trends in the ionosphere in connection to atmospheric long-term dynamics and geophysical phenomena. Specifically, DISPEC derived high-level data products aim at:
- Providing fast processing of time series that lead to curated data.
- Deriving new high-level data products based on the exploitation of raw data from multi-locations and multi-instruments, useful for input to ionospheric specification models.
- Deriving new ionospheric indicators based on the post-processing of raw satellite and ground-based instruments’ data useful for a quick mapping of ongoing ionospheric irregularities.
- Providing proxies for geophysical phenomena and long-term trends in the ionosphere.

The main objective of DISPEC project is the exploitation of bottomside and topside ionospheric data, provided by space missions – such as Swarm, DORIS, GRACE, GRACE-FO, Spire, COSMIC-2 – and by ground-based GNSS receivers and ionosonde sounders, to support research activities for improved ionospheric specification, through the derivation of high-level data products. The project outcomes have the potential to complement the ESA Space Science Archives and the Space Weather Network, the data collections provided by the global networks of ionosondes and GNSS ground based receivers, and to enhance the capacity of European Research Infrastructures.

Name: Observatoire Radioastronomique de Nançay
Description:
L’Observatoire Radioastronomique de Nançay est à la fois un département de l’Observatoire de Paris et une unité associée au CNRS/INSU (UAR704) et à l’Université d’Orléans.
Elle est membre de l’OSUC, Observatoire de Sciences de l’Univers en région Centre, dont elle est un des 3 laboratoires fondateurs.

L’Observatoire de Nançay, à la fois site d’observation et laboratoire instrumental, est spécialisée dans le domaine de la radioastronomie basse fréquence (30 MHz à 10 GHz).

Name: OrbitResQ
Description: OrbitResQ is a space-enabled disaster response platform that combines satellite data, AI, and geospatial intelligence to enhance preparedness and emergency response. Our real-time dashboard integrates crisis mapping, evacuation planning, and a digital triage tool to support decision-makers and first responders during large-scale emergencies. By bridging space technology with on-the-ground needs, OrbitResQ delivers actionable insights that improve coordination and save lives when every second counts.

Name: Atelier Arth
Description: Atelier Arth is an art-tech studio focusing on implementing artistic design-thinking approaches in tech-driven projects, particularly in the space industry. The driving motivation is to bridge the gap between cutting-edge technology and the end-user, especially in the context of a rural or less developed community.

Name: Datlas Grenoble
Description: Datlas was created in Oct. 2021 by a team of scientists experts in numerical modeling and numerical methods in Earth and Environmental sciences.

Name: HumanImpulses
Description: Human Impulse regroupe des projets innovants écoresponsables. Le projet principal est celui des HPA (Human Powered Aircraft) ou Avion à Propulsion Musculaire. Ce projet collaboratif a pour objectif de concevoir et réaliser des avions français pour développer l'activité HPA et battre des records.

Name: Aranrod
Description:
Aranrod is a space sustainability company focused on giving a second life to ground infrastructures used by the space sector. As the number of space missions continues to grow, ensuring that the supporting infrastructure on Earth evolves in a sustainable way has become a critical challenge.

Aranrod develops solutions dedicated to the recycling, repurposing, and sustainable management of space-related ground infrastructure, including antennas, radar systems, and micro-launcher launch bases. Our objective is to reduce environmental impact while optimizing the lifecycle of strategic assets that support space activities.

By transforming existing infrastructure into valuable resources for future space operations, Aranrod contributes to building a more responsible and circular space ecosystem, from the ground to orbit.

Aranrod is a spin-off of Cosmos for Humanity, created to turn research and vision into practical solutions that support sustainable development in the space sector.

Through collaboration with industry partners, institutions, and emerging launch providers, Aranrod aims to enable a new model for space infrastructure: efficient, circular, and sustainable.

Name: blue-Amber
Description: The ESD & ARCfree Solutions for your Spacecraft

Name: iRobotics
Description:
INPECTIONS ROBOTICS LABS (IROBOTICS) is a laboratory providing geographic data acquisition (GIS), industrial inspections and aerial imagery combining drones (UAV) and artificial intelligence Based in Benin.

We bring together in-depth knowledge and experience in geodesy, topographic surveys with RTK drones, CVI, thermal and lidar inspections, aerial imagery and 3D visualizations and rope work.

Name: Vulcanis
Description: Custom remote sensing and subsurface sensing for mining, defense and space

Name: findgs
Description:
The global ground station market is a fragmented landscape of vertically-integrated providers. This creates immense complexity and capital inefficiency for any satellite operator trying to build a resilient, cost-effective network. Guesswork and spreadsheets are no longer sufficient to solve this multi-variable problem.

find-gs.com is an intelligence platform that replaces guesswork with mathematics. Our optimization engine ingests mission parameters and budgetary constraints to design a provably optimal, hybrid, multi-provider ground segment plan. We provide satellite operators with a data-driven blueprint to maximize their data throughput while minimizing their operational cost.

Founded by an ex-ESA Mission Control engineer, our mission is to provide the definitive strategic planning and procurement engine for the NewSpace economy.

Name: Parsec Scale
Description:
Parsec Scale was founded with one simple idea in mind: advance the progress on Earth and in space by bringing ideas and concepts to market. We work with startups, small and mid-size companies, incubators, accelerators, scientists, and nonprofits to help them bring technologies and their vision to life for the benefit of humanity.

We provide the following services: 
- Technology Scouting
- Research and Feasibility Studies
- Market Research and Competitiveness
- Technology Assessment and Evaluation
- Strategic Planning and Foresight
- Partnerships Strategy
- Technical and Grant Writing
- Project Management
- Consulting for Nonprofits

We work worldwide. Don't hesitate to write to us, let's work together to bring technologies for Earth and space!

Name: GABRIEL-Technologies
Description:
Gabriel Technologies is a research and developement company in the field of satellite IoT, bringing true global two-way connectivity at an affordable price. Based on Low Orbit Mini Satellite constellations, it designs and manufactures connectivity beacons and applied devices for all activity sectors. Sensor agnostic, GABRIEL is the first device that is both a gateway and a stand alone two way communication equipment. 
It was created by three friends and partners who believed in bringing high end technology to the public, while giving farmers, fish farms, medical units and all other good-willed entities a capability to monitor and control sensors no matter their location. 
We wish to bring this technology to help global actors make a difference in the way they approach modern crop raising or remote medicine, water monitoring or wild fire prevention. 
Gabriel Technologies is a French based company with a global reach.

Name: BlueMUSE
Description: BlueMUSE is an optical seeing-limited, blue-optimised, medium spectral resolution, panoramic integral-field-spectrograph, to be installed on one of the telescopes of the VLT on Cerro Paranal (Chile).

Name: ASTRAL
Description:
Astral, anciennement ESO Laval, est l’association spatiale et technologique de l’ESTACA 
Laval.
Créée en 2025, elle a pour mission de permettre aux étudiants de développer des projets 
spatiaux concrets, en complément de leur formation d’ingénieur.
Chaque année, Astral conçoit et réalise des mini-fusées et fusées expérimentales, lancées lors 
de la campagne CSpace, en partenariat avec le CNES.
L’association organise également des événements autour du spatial : soirées astronomie, 
visites d’entreprises et conférences techniques.
Location: Laval, Pays de la Loire, France

Name: Novaheim orbitals
Description:
Novaheim Orbitals (NHO) développe l'infrastructure autonome de servicing orbital qui manque aujourd'hui à l'Europe. Un satellite en panne, mal positionné ou à court de carburant, c'est un actif de plusieurs dizaines de millions d'euros perdu — et un débris de plus en orbite.

Notre réponse : des drones de servicing autonomes (NHO-DART) capables d'inspecter, réparer, repositionner et ravitailler les satellites en orbite basse, appuyés par une plateforme orbitale modulaire (NHO-HIVE) faisant office de hub logistique et de ravitaillement.

Nous commençons par le servicing de satellites, avant d'étendre nos services à l'assistance des stations spatiales commerciales habitées.

Notre ambition : bâtir une chaîne de servicing orbital européenne, souveraine et de bout en bout.

 Basés en Nouvelle-Aquitaine, au cœur de l'écosystème Aerospace Valley.

Name: iSenses Inc.
Description:
iSenses is a machine intelligence company providing products and solutions for autonomy, imaging, and digitization of assets, processes, and services. 

Our patented neocortex-based algorithm in near-real-time (≤ 10 ms) detects, tracks, learns, classifies, identifies, and ranges multiple objects, persons, events of interest (EOI) or anomalies. 

Applications are in the domain of automotive, aerospace, satellite downstream, predictive analytics,  and managed services. 

In the area of automotive, the noteworthy applications are advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), assisted driving (AD), simultaneous localization, mapping and path planning, detection of lanes and traffic signs in normal and adverse driving conditions of rainfall, snowfall, fog, haze, sandstorm, and occlusions, multiple vehicles, pedestrians, bicyclists, animals detection, driver behavior analytics.

Name: CevoteQ | Centre d'étude des évolutions des technologies quantiques
The Space Devs
Description: Nonprofit developing, maintaining & promoting the Launch Library 2 and Spaceflight News APIs.

Name: Innoffience Engineering
Description:
Founded in 2024, Innoffience Engineering is your strategic partner for tackling the most complex technical challenges in the space domain. We empower companies in the sector (space surveillance, satellite operations, etc.) to achieve their ambitions by focusing on three key areas:

--> Expert Technical Training: Elevate your teams' skills, from foundational knowledge to ultra-specific subjects, for increased autonomy and efficiency.

--> Strategic Technical Consulting: Benefit from expert guidance to make informed decisions, optimize your processes, and navigate into technical complexities.

-->  Feasibility Studies & Custom Tool Development: Transform your concepts into concrete solutions with our in-depth studies and innovative and custom software tools, designed to maximize your operational effectiveness.

We are committed to driving innovation and excellence at the heart of your space projects.

Name: ema-enac
Description: The Electromagnetics and Antennas (EMA) research group is part of the Telecommunication team of the ENAC laboratory. This group carries out research and studies on electromagnetics and antennas. Its activity is mainly focused on the Communication, Navigation, and Surveillance (CNS) systems for civil aviation.

Name: U3P - Union pour la Promotion de la Propulsion Photonique
Description:
L’Union pour la Promotion de la Propulsion Photonique (U3P) est une association à but non lucratif, fondée en 1981, dont le but est de mieux faire connaître les enjeux de la propulsion photonique pour une exploration et une exploitation pacifiques de l’espace, en initiant et soutenant des projets concrets comme la course Terre-Lune de voiliers solaires. 

Elle est basée au Centre Culturel Spatial Rico Nourry (Ferme équestre du Grand Étang) à Saint-Benoît de la Réunion.

Reconnue d'intérêt général, l'association est habilitée à délivrer des reçus fiscaux ouvrant droit à un crédit d'impôt de 66 % pour les particuliers et 60 % pour les personnes morales pour les dons et les adhésions dont elle bénéficie.

Name: AstREA
Description:
Notre association s’engage à accompagner les élèves, jeunes et étudiants dans la découverte et l’étude du domaine spatial et de l’astronautique.

 Nous offrons un accompagnement éducatif à travers du soutien, des ateliers et des ressources permettant de mieux comprendre les sciences et technologies spatiales.

 Nous développons des projets de conception, de fabrication et de lancement de fusées afin de proposer une expérience pratique immersive.

 Nous menons des actions de sensibilisation et de vulgarisation pour promouvoir l’éducation aux sciences et technologies spatiales auprès du grand public et des jeunes générations.

Name: Students in Microgravity (SIM)
Description:
SIM is a student association of ISAE Supaero which take interest in human spaceflight and space medecine.

As part of ISAE Supaero "MARS Club", a bigger student association that tackle multiple issues regarding Human Space Exploration. Right now, SIM is formed by a team of 13 multi-disciplinar, multi-cultural engineering students.  Most of them, were part of the previous Artery in Microgravity (AIM) project, an experiment which took 5 years to design and is going to be inboard the ISS as part of the "Orbit your thesis" by European Space Agency.

SIM is personally endorsed by Mrs Stéphanie LIZY-DESTREZ, professor at Supaero and Co-founder & Chief Training Officer at "Spaceflight Institute"

Name: Broader
Description: At Broader, we design and build custom interfaces for geospatial, 3D, and deep tech data, turning complex datasets into intuitive, actionable solutions for industries like satellite tech, IoT, and urban planning.

Name: DREAM Parabole étudiants 2024
Description: Projet parabole étudiant 2024 DREAM ( DRone En Accélérations Modifiées ) vise à développer et à concevoir un drone quadricoptère pouvant effectuer un vol stationnaire automatique dans l’ensemble du domaine d’accélération d’un vol parabolique.

Name: Origine Labs
Description:
Origine Labs is an independent engineering studio building scientific instruments and advanced technology from first principles.
We design, prototype, and validate systems across optics, astronomy instrumentation, embedded electronics, and applied physics — bridging theory with real-world hardware. Our work combines rigorous science, clean engineering, and an obsession for precision.

Science, Engineered.

Origine Labs — Astrotechnica

Astrotechnica is the astronomy and optics division of Origine Labs, focused on scientific instruments for astronomy, optics, and adaptive optics. We document the full engineering journey — from theoretical models and system design to prototyping, measurement, validation, and iteration.

Origine Labs also explores related technical fields including radio astronomy, microwave engineering, signal processing, mathematics, cryptography, and open-source intelligence.

Origine Labs is a civilian R&D initiative and does not engage in military or defense activities.

Name: International Academy of Astronautics SETI Committee
Description:
The International Academy of Astronautics (IAA) SETI Committee advances the scientific Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence (SETI). Established in the 1970s, the Committee brings together leading experts to explore both the technical search for technosignatures and the societal implications of potential contact.

We organise SETI sessions at the annual International Astronautical Congress, lead workshops and studies, and promote education and student involvement in SETI research worldwide. 

You can subscribe to our IAA SETI Community email exploder by sending an email to community+subscribe@iaaseti.org.

Name: Kirian Technologies
Description: Kirian Technologies was created in early 2023 after years of ideas maturation. It now focuses on research projects aimed at revolutionizing several engineering domains like electrical space engine technologies, energy generation, air conditioning systems and other software or gaming related domains.

Name: Project LACRA
Description:
After obtaining a balloon flight ticket from the French space agency CNES students of M2TSI work on a cubesat based balloon, LACRA (Lab for Aerosol Counting Research in the Atmosphere). This cubesat carries Two experiments on board in a stratospheric flight; one is an exact copy of the main instrument of ALMA, the OSAC, and the other one is the METEO France OPC (Optical Particle Counter).
The launch of LACRA successfully took place at the end of March and is a collaboration between Université Paul Sabatier Toulouse III, CNES, UNIVERSEH European University, ISAE Supaero, Luleå University of Technology and METEO France.

Name: Sirius Space Vision
Description:
Sirius Space Vision: 
A forefront advocate for space debris awareness and surveillance.
Shaping a secure orbital future through pioneering debris management.

Name: X-Space | Polytechnique Alumni
Description:
Cette page connecte sur LinkedIn les membres de X-Space, chapitre spatial de l'Association des Alumni de l'École polytechnique.

Nous partageons ici un aperçu de nos visites, événements et découvertes dans le secteur spatial.

Name: Spica Space Technologies
Description: Spica Space Technologies est une association 1901 créée par des passionnés d'astronomie, d'astrophysique, d'informatique et de géopolitique spatiale. Notre but est de partager nos passions, et potentiellement de lancer quelques fusées !

Name: Payankeu Voile Solaire
Description: Nous sommes une association de passionnés basée à la Réunion. Nous fabriquons notre propre voilier solaire afin de proposer une réponse au challenge Terre-Lune (Fédération Internationale d'Astronautique), visant à photographier la face cachée de la Lune. Ce projet est soutenu par l'Université de la Réunion et l'Union pour la Promotion de la Propulsion Photonique (U3P). La plupart d'entre nous fait partie de l'association PIKALI, de l'université de la Réunion (étudiants, professeurs, chercheurs), de l'U3P (étudiants, doctorants, ingénieurs) ou encore de la Reunion Island Space Initiative.

Name: AstroÇanakkale

Name: GSTAC – Global Space Technology & Aerospace Congress
Description:
GSTAC – Global Space Technology & Aerospace Congress is an international platform connecting researchers, industry leaders, space agencies, startups, and policymakers in the fields of space technology, aerospace engineering, satellite systems, planetary exploration, and emerging aerospace innovations.

GSTAC promotes global collaboration through keynote presentations, technical sessions, panel discussions, networking opportunities, and industry-academia partnerships

Name: Why Space Matters
Description:
Why Space Matters is a podcast and narrative platform examining how the emerging space economy is reshaping life on Earth — from national security and energy to communications, climate, and global infrastructure.

Through in-depth conversations with operators, engineers, investors, and policymakers, the podcast explores the technologies, systems, and decisions shaping the next era of space infrastructure. The focus is practical and grounded: what is working, what is scaling, and what truly matters as space becomes critical infrastructure.

Why Space Matters serves as a public-facing platform aligned with the HUMANUS.VC ecosystem and its partners, helping frame the strategic importance of space across defense, energy resilience, and long-term economic systems.

Originally launched as a podcast, the platform is evolving into a broader narrative and engagement layer for leaders building and investing in the space economy.

Name: Datum Vega
Description:
Datum Vega is a specialized aerospace engineering consultancy and software development firm dedicated to closing the gap between initial design concepts and final, qualified space hardware.

We help aerospace teams streamline their workflows, ensuring that requirements are defined, tracked, and validated with precision. By integrating engineering rigor with modern, automated digital workflows, we help our partners reduce project risk and accelerate their path to qualification.

With deep experience in structural dynamics and mission-critical systems, we provide the technical depth necessary to transform complex, fragmented engineering cycles into unified, high-performance pipelines. We are committed to solving the fundamental bottlenecks that stand between an engineering vision and a successful, flight-ready product.

Name: Foxtek Technology Systems
Description: Foxtek Technology Systems propose des solutions innovantes basées sur la recherche et le développement, avec un accent sur les technologies Arduino pour l'industrie et le grand public. Découvrez nos projets et produits pour une intégration efficace dans divers domaines industriels et applications grand public.

Name: Bordeaux-Nanterre Propulsion
Description: Bordeaux-Nanterre Propulsion est une alliance entre les clubs étudiants CESINOVA (du CESI Bordeaux) et CESI AERO (du CESI Nanterre) dont le but est de concevoir une fusée expérimentale pour le CSpace 2026

Name: CONVERS CONSULTING
Description: Space FPGA expert, computer vision and radars. Architecture, developments and validation of electronics systems.

Name: QUSPID
Description:
Galileo, Europe’s cutting-edge satellite navigation system, is setting new standards with its Quasi-Pilot (QP) signal, a technological breakthrough and game-changing innovation. Compatible with legacy systems, this signal reduces Time to First Fix, lowers energy consumption through simplified signal acquisition, and enhances performance for demanding applications and challenging environments and is designed to resist interference.

The QUSPID (QUaSi PIlot Development) project will validate through two Proof of Concept the added value of that new Quasi-Pilot (QP) signal.

The QUSPID Consortium brings together some major players in the field of GNSS with #ST Microelectronics, #Thales Alenia Space France, #Saphyrion and #FDC leading the QUSPID Project

"This project has received funding from the European Union under grant agreement EUSPA/GRANT/03/2024-01".

Name: TimeBox UTC
Description: TimeBox is a device designed to date a PC/Server time and digital video recordings with the Universal Time (UTC). The TimeBox was primarily designed for precise timing of astronomic phenomena, but it can be used for other applications that require precise timing with an absolute time reference (UTC).

Description: Nous proposons un nouveau système de pompage pour les lasers haute intensité utilisant la technologie des concentrateurs lumineux, développée dans les laboratoires du Laboratoire Charles-Fabry (LCF).

Name: S.T.A.R Group
Description: Groupe d'Entreprises sur les secteurs de l'Aérospatiale, de la Robotique, du Marketing, de la Finance et du développement web.

Description: Synchrotron radiation beamline at the ESRF dedicated to XAS.

Name: Exonarium
Description: We are a team of engineers and scientists whose mission is to bring cutting-edge technology to space.

Name: OrbitFlow
Description:
OrbitFlow is a modern Cloud-to-Edge platform built to streamline and secure ground station operations for universities, research labs, and New Space actors.

While space hardware has evolved rapidly, the software used to communicate with satellites has remained fragmented and difficult to scale. OrbitFlow eliminates this bottleneck by offering an intuitive, automated, and highly secure web ecosystem for satellite tracking and data downlink.

Behind OrbitFlow is a team of software engineering students. For our graduation project, we decided to step out of our comfort zone and tackle a massive challenge in an industry that was entirely new to us: the Space sector.

We are bringing modern Web standards to ground station operations, learning, building, and innovating every step of the way.

Follow our journey as we build the future of sovereign satellite data access!

Name: L.A.M.E Energy
Description:
Nous sommes un groupe de jeunes talentueux entrepreneurs et ingénieurs aux idées révolutionnaires qui, nous l'espérons, contribueront à changer le monde.
Nous fournissons des solutions intelligentes à des entreprises d'aéronautique, fiers de notre service hors pair et dévoué.
Chez LAME Energy, nous sommes conscients que la compréhension et l'avantage technologique peuvent mener les entreprises comme la nôtre vers la réussite.
